analysis.reason: 직전 2거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확신하기에는 미약한 수준. 5일 저가 20일 저가 상회는 확인되었으나, 5일 고가 < 20일 고가 하락 패턴으로 약화 신호가 혼재되어 방향성 부재. ADX 30.1로 뚜렷한 추세는 형성되었으나, -DI(33.8)가 +DI(19.5)보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 잔존. 현재가 49,710원은 SMA20(56,855원) 하회, SMA5(48,109원) 상회하며 중립 구간에서 횡보 중. 변동성 ATR(12.72%) 고려 시, 1.3배 ATR 손절(약 8,217원) 적용 시 진입가 49,710원 기준 손절 41,493원, 목표가 62,567원 (손익비 1.5 이상) 설정 가능하나, 명확한 추세 전환 신호 부재로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for two consecutive sessions. RSI is consolidating in the neutral zone after exiting oversold territory, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, it's not strong enough to confirm a trend reversal. A higher low compared to the 5-day low versus the 20-day low is confirmed, but mixed signals with a lower high compared to the 5-day high versus the 20-day high indicate a lack of directional conviction. ADX at 30.1 suggests a clear trend, but the -DI (33.8) remains above the +DI (19.5), indicating residual downward pressure. The current price of 49,710 KRW is below the SMA20 (56,855 KRW) and above the SMA5 (48,109 KRW), consolidating in the neutral zone. Considering the ATR (12.72%), a 1.3x ATR stop loss (approx. 8,217 KRW) from an entry of 49,710 KRW would set the stop at 41,493 KRW and target at 62,567 KRW (risk/reward > 1.5), but the absence of clear trend reversal signals warrants a cautious stance.

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (49,710 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (48,109 KRW/56,855 KRW/77,656 KRW): Short-term trend above SMA5, mid-term trend below SMA20, confirming consolidation range.
· Significant drop vs SMA100/200 (95,266 KRW/112,039 KRW): Maintaining strong weakness in the long-term trend.
· 52-Week Position (5.0%): Current price level is high relative to the 52-week low (39,310 KRW) but very low historically relative to the high (246,440 KRW).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (33.1→39.0): Exited oversold, continuing in the neutral zone, weakening upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (159.8337→309.3369): Improving in negative territory, but signals for a bearish reversal are still weak.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band 56,855 KRW): Consolidating around the middle band, with a band width of 57.44% indicating potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (41,000 KRW): Applying 1.3x ATR (approx. 8,217 KRW) results in a stop loss near 41,493 KRW from an entry of 49,710 KRW, a higher support level than Pivot S1 (36,642 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (65,285 KRW): Significant distance from the current price; a breakout could signal a trend reversal.
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern (No Higher Low confirmed, No Lower High confirmed): Consolidation range, lack of direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.12x): Normal level compared to the 5-day average, indicating moderate confidence in the price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Absence of clear trend reversal signals, maintaining a wait-and-see condition.
